verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents keyboard shortcuts through a shortcuts reference page with a Shift-? key overlay, and a Superhuman user found it productive thanks to those shortcuts. Speed is supported by a user praising the interface's speed and the founder citing low-latency real-time updates. No command palette is evidenced, and the extent of shortcut coverage is not shown. Missing for 10: any evidence of a command palette, documentation showing comprehensive keyboard-only operation, independent performance measurements.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
